question: HLA-B27 is strongly associated with seronegative spondyloarthropathies such as ankylosing spondylitis, reactive arthritis, and psoriatic spondylitis.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is TRUE. HLA-B27 is the major histocompatibility complex class I allele most strongly linked to seronegative spondyloarthropathies, particularly ankylosing spondylitis (~90%), reactive arthritis, and psoriatic spondylitis.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. HLA-B27 is present in >90% of patients with ankylosing spondylitis and is a key genetic marker for the seronegative spondyloarthropathy group. Its detection supports (but does not confirm) the diagnosis.
